question: Should remindctl expose Apple Reminders tags as a supported cross-version CLI contract, and should `edit --tags` replace tags or support separate incremental operations?
rationale: This adds public CLI behavior and requires a supported-platform decision; the unavailable source review prevents safely inferring existing project policy or API feasibility.

options.title: Sponsor a native tags contract
options.body: Define supported macOS versions and edit semantics, then implement and test one consistent tags surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep tags outside the CLI if a stable EventKit implementation cannot be supported across the documented platform range.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a native tags contract
recommendation.body: Define supported macOS versions and edit semantics, then implement and test one consistent tags surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on adjacent EventKit-backed add/edit behavior makes this the best available routing candidate, with low confidence.
